title: Daq footer
description: A window-tall closing footer: a large two-weight sentence-case call to action at the left, a short line and a long square CTA bar ending in a solid arrow square at the right, then four columns split by hairlines (numbered monospace headings, tracked uppercase links with small arrows, the wordmark with a two-tone tagline, and the small print with a back-to-top link). Links brighten and their arrows nudge on hover.
notes: transparent: made to sit over daq-backdrop; pass a background in className without it
100svh tall from 1024px, as on the original; content-sized on phones
